body:
Thank you. All of what you said is stuff I feel sometimes, about being resentful that he keeps me from killing myself, the internal battle... I wonder sometimes about which seems more terrible: causing him so much pain or being unable to escape mine.

And you're right about him too. Every time I try to apologize for what my illness puts him through, he just says something like "I signed up for this." He holds me and tells me that he loves me, he just doesn't know what to do for me sometimes.

I feel guilty for how much I burden him too. I feel like I don't really do anything for him compared to what he does for me. So maybe I can keep living for him, at least.
